bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to housing; modifying the appropriation for assistance to homeless families, those at risk of homelessness, or highly mobile families; amending Laws 2025, chapter 32, article 1, section 2, subdivision 8.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Laws 2025, chapter 32, article 1, section 2, subdivision 8, is amended to read:

Subd. 8.
Homework Starts with Home

2,750,000

2,750,000

[+(a) +]This appropriation is for the homework starts with home program under Minnesota Statutes, sections 462A.201, subdivision 2, paragraph (a), clause (4), and 462A.204, subdivision 8, to provide assistance to homeless families, those at risk of homelessness, or highly mobile families.

[+(b) $1,000,000 of the appropriation for fiscal year 2027 is for a grant to the Minneapolis Public Housing Authority for the stable homes stable schools partnership, to provide housing stability and homelessness prevention services for families with school-aged children in the city of Minneapolis. Notwithstanding any guidelines, requests for proposals, scoring criteria, or competitive selection requirements, the agency must award a grant of $2,000,000 in fiscal years 2028 and 2029 to the Minneapolis Public Housing Authority for the stable homes stable schools partnership. These appropriations are available until expended. +]

[+(c) The base for this program in fiscal year 2028 and beyond is $2,000,000. +]
